title: Crimson Vow Commander: card flavor text

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire whose wedding draws the elite, and who orders her guests' uninvited followers disposed of.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel whose grace and absence are felt by Donal and by the Angel of Flight Alabaster.

entities.name: Donal, Herald of Wings
entities.description: A figure who sees a flicker of Avacyn's grace in every wingbeat.

entities.name: Angel of Flight Alabaster
entities.description: An angel who endures without Avacyn and asks each soul she guides whether they have seen her.

entities.name: Moormanor
entities.description: A place whose library was open to all before the Travails.

entities.name: the Travails
entities.description: A calamity on Innistrad before which the Moormanor library was open to all.

entities.name: Lady Anje
entities.description: A figure who ordered no violence at the wedding.

entities.name: Squire Imalia
entities.description: Savior of Thiswick who says her foes had it coming.

entities.name: Thiswick
entities.description: A place saved by Squire Imalia.

entities.name: Agnur
entities.description: A person who learns that ethereal spirits' blades are solid and razor-sharp.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi imprisoned in the moon, held by the only vault great enough.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: An angelic avenger who praises a muse's voice as justice.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: A faerie queen whose song calls all faeries home so she can feast on the dreams and rumors they serve her.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane of great diversity, unknown to the Mirror Entity.

entities.name: Mu Yanling
entities.description: A speaker who says she wept a torrent to scour the land clean.

entities.name: Toshiro Umezawa
entities.description: A speaker who likens a masterless kami to himself.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: A speaker who warns that the bonders work with creatures that know everything.

entities.name: Admiral Beckett Brass
entities.description: A ship's admiral who says long-sailing ships pick up ghosts.

entities.name: Barvisa
entities.description: An Azorius emissary who says only truth exists in the Verity Circle.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Azorius governing body whose personnel Dovin Baan wants tracked with lockets.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: An Azorius figure who mandates lockets to track Senate personnel.

entities.name: Siara
entities.description: The Dragon's Mouth, who speaks of Silumgar's mind.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragon whose mind is a dark labyrinth of grim secrets and subtle traps.

entities.name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
entities.description: An ancient vampire who scorns Chandra Nalaar for holding a map many died seeking.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker called an arrogant child by Anowon, who now holds a coveted map.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: A figure who fancies himself king of the undercity but is merely king of rot.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who claims to have seen things that would reduce weaker people to raving.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: A vampire who speaks of blood as a vintage and demands the slaying of trespassers.

entities.name: Sanctum Seekers
entities.description: The first knightly order to cross the sea and still the most zealous.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A Knight-Cathar who declares that holy places and death are no longer sanctuary.

entities.name: Kenjek
entities.description: Captain of the Thousand Swords who praises rushing headlong into combat if prepared.

entities.name: Thousand Swords
entities.description: A force captained by Kenjek.

entities.name: Pulan
entities.description: A Bant orchardist who tells of trees transformed overnight.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A region of Alara home to orchardists.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who says people worship whoever answers when gods are apathetic.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region whose coastal cities are shrouded by the haunted fog Nebelgast.

entities.name: Nebelgast
entities.description: A haunted fog that shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

entities.name: Ondu
entities.description: A continent that is a vast plateau crisscrossed by deep trenches and meandering rivers.

entities.name: Guul Draz
entities.description: A continent that is a geothermal swampland reeking of heat and decay.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings fought by vampires, who then learned to live among humans.

entities.name: Magic Mirror
entities.description: An artifact that crystallized a drop of water into the Arcane Signet.

entities.name: Mirror Entity
entities.description: A being unaware of Lorwyn's diversity, seeing only itself reflected a thousand times.

entities.name: Izzet
entities.description: A guild whose mage cannot recover her thermoinverter.

entities.name: Blessed Sleep
entities.description: A rest that does not come easily to a mind chained by regrets.

entities.name: Skyclave
entities.description: A place with an inscription about the swarm rising on vile wings.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A guild whose signets are not finished until used as a murder weapon.

entities.name: Gnolls
entities.description: Creatures who make offerings to sinister forces in shadow-drenched chasms.

events.summary: Donal sees a flicker of Avacyn's grace in every wingbeat.
events.quote: He sees a flicker of Avacyn's grace in every wingbeat.

events.summary: The Moormanor library continues to attract visitors after the Travails.
events.quote: The library of Moormanor had been open to all before the Travails, and it continues to attract curious visitors.

events.summary: Olivia orders uninvited wedding crashers disposed of.
events.quote: These worthless cattle think they can sneak unnoticed into my wedding? Dispose of them.

events.summary: Squire Imalia says the mighty had it coming after saving Thiswick.
events.quote: They had it coming.

events.summary: Agnur learns that spirits' blades are solid and razor-sharp.
events.quote: Though the spirits' bodies were ethereal, Agnur soon learned that their blades were quite solid—and razor-sharp.

events.summary: The Angel of Flight Alabaster endures without Avacyn and secretly asks souls whether they have seen her.
events.quote: She endures without Avacyn but secretly asks each soul she guides if they have seen her.

events.summary: Emrakul is imprisoned in the moon.
events.quote: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

events.summary: Akroma praises a muse's voice as justice.
events.quote: Her voice is justice, clear and relentless.

events.summary: Oona's song calls all faeries home so she can feast on their stolen dreams and rumors.
events.quote: All the faeries return home, but it is Oona who feasts—on the stolen dreams and rumors they serve her.

events.summary: Mu Yanling says she wept a torrent to scour the land clean.
events.quote: I have wept such a torrent as to scour the land clean.

events.summary: Toshiro Umezawa compares a masterless kami to himself.
events.quote: He's a lot like me, that masterless little kami . . . unimpressed by grandeur and never at a loss for a trick.

events.summary: Jirina Kudro warns that the bonders know everything.
events.quote: The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything.

events.summary: Admiral Beckett Brass notes ships on mean seas pick up ghosts.
events.quote: Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two.

events.summary: Barvisa declares there is only truth in the Verity Circle.
events.quote: Here, there is only truth.

events.summary: Anowon scorns Chandra Nalaar for holding the map many died seeking.
events.quote: So many have died in search of that map. And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar.

events.summary: Siara describes Silumgar's mind as a dark labyrinth.
events.quote: Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps.

events.summary: Jarad is mocked as king of rot.
events.quote: Jarad fancies himself king of the undercity, but he's merely king of rot.

events.summary: Vraska boasts of having seen things that would unhinge weaker people.
events.quote: I have seen things that would reduce a weaker person to blubbering and raving. Want to hear about them?

events.summary: Runo Stromkirk orders his followers to slay all who trespass.
events.quote: No longer can we allow our human populations to be mindlessly slaughtered by ghouls. Slay all who trespass.

events.summary: Thalia declares that neither holy places nor death are sanctuary any more.
events.quote: Holy places are no longer sanctuary from death, and death is no longer sanctuary from anything.

events.summary: Vampires fighting the Eldrazi learned to live among humans, though not all adjusted.
events.quote: As they fought the Eldrazi, many vampires learned to live among humans.

events.summary: The Sanctum Seekers were the first knightly order to cross the sea.
events.quote: The Sanctum Seekers were the first of the knightly orders to cross the sea and are still the most zealous.

events.summary: Dovin Baan mandates lockets to track Senate personnel.
events.quote: Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency.

events.summary: The Magic Mirror crystallizes a drop of water into much more.
events.quote: It started as a mere drop of water. The Magic Mirror crystallized it into much more.

events.summary: Kenjek counsels being prepared before rushing into combat.
events.quote: There is great wisdom in rushing headlong into combat . . . if you're prepared.

events.summary: Pulan tells how Bant trees were transformed overnight.
events.quote: When we awoke, we found our trees transformed.

events.summary: Kiora remarks that people worship whoever answers when gods are apathetic.
events.quote: When gods become apathetic, the people will worship anyone who answers their pleas.

events.summary: A haunted fog, the Nebelgast, shrouds Nephalia's coastal cities.
events.quote: A haunted fog known as the Nebelgast shrouds the cities along Nephalia's coast.

events.summary: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in shadowy chasms.
events.quote: Gnolls make offerings to sinister forces in the shadow-drenched chasms.

relations.note: Siara is called the Dragon's Mouth and speaks of Silumgar's mind.
relations.quote: Silumgar's mind is a dark labyrinth, full of grim secrets and subtle traps.

relations.note: Anowon scorns Chandra as an arrogant child.
relations.quote: And now it appears in the hands of the arrogant child Chandra Nalaar.

relations.note: Dovin Baan mandates security measures for Senate personnel.
relations.quote: Mandatory lockets enable the tracking of all Senate personnel for improved security and efficiency.
